overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that checking for a trailing path separator would correctly distinguish between typing a drive root (Q:\) and navigating into a child folder, but on Windows drive roots like Q:\ are both valid folder URIs and have trailing separators.
why_it_breaks: When typing Q:\ character by character on Windows, the path has a trailing separator but represents a drive root folder that should trigger tryUpdateItems. The new condition blocks this because hasTrailingPathSeparator returns true for Q:\, causing the code to skip the else-if branch that would call tryUpdateItems, so the picker never refreshes to show Q:\'s contents.

evidence.quote: Exclude trailing-separator folder URIs from the direct-child selection shortcut.
Add a platform-independent regression test for navigating from POSIX root.
